actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Seed of the environment's random generator
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

inputs.description: Seed used by the next reset
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: seed

facts.text: The task is registered as WorldComposer-Tableware-v0 with entry point Tableware:TablewareEnv and TablewareEnvCfg as its environment configuration
TablewareEnv subclasses DirectRLEnv imported from isaaclab.envs, so the Gymnasium base, the action and observation space objects and the episode time limit live in the external Isaac Lab package
TablewareEnv takes the environment configuration cfg and an optional render_mode
The task config sets decimation 1, episode_length_s 60, action_scale 1.0, action_space 6, observation_space 6 and state_space 0
The simulation step is dt = 1/120 s, with render_interval equal to decimation 1
The robot is an SO101 follower whose default joint positions are shoulder_pan -0.0363, shoulder_lift -1.7135, elbow_flex 1.4979, wrist_flex -1.5, wrist_roll -0.085 and gripper -0.01176
The SO101 action joint order is shoulder_pan, shoulder_lift, elbow_flex, wrist_flex, wrist_roll, gripper
_pre_physics_step multiplies the action by action_scale and _apply_action sets it as the robot joint position target
_get_observations returns a dict with the applied action and the six joint positions under the keys action and observation.state
The episode ends when episode_length_buf reaches max_episode_length - 1, and the same time-out flag is returned as both terminated and truncated
Camera observations are added only when task_config.teleop.enable_cameras is true: top and wrist RGB and, unless disable_depth is true, depth images
The wrist and top cameras are configured at 960 x 720 pixels with rgb and depth data types
The success check compares the XY distance between objects A and B and requires both distances to be at most 0.035 m
Installation creates a Python 3.11 environment, installs torch 2.7.0, lerobot 0.4.1 and isaacsim[all,extscache], then installs source/WorldComposer in editable mode
The simulation assets are downloaded from the Hugging Face WorldComposer_Assets dataset into Assets/
The package setup requires Python 3.10 or newer and declares the Apache-2.0 license

determinism.notes: reset(seed=...) and cap.world.seed.v1 set the seed of the next reset, and the fake's state update is deterministic. The upstream reset randomizes object instances, scale, position, texture and lighting (Tableware.py:157 onwards) and the upstream Isaac Sim environment was not run, so its own determinism is not claimed and the two were not compared.

gaps: kinematic F0 stand-in: no Isaac Sim physics, rigid bodies, contacts, actuator, sensor, noise or rendering model; the fake applies the action directly as the joint positions and claims no dynamics

the real action and observation space objects are created by the external DirectRLEnv and were not inspected; the fake exposes unbounded six-value Boxes and neither rejects nor clamps a finite action, so no action limit is published

the observation is the two-key dict of Tableware.py:110-113 with six values each; the camera keys that task_config.teleop.enable_cameras adds (Tableware.py:115-129) are not represented and the fake returns no image arrays, while the real wrist and top cameras are 960 x 720 rgb and depth (Tableware_cfg.py:42-79)

the fake serves one environment with the default joint positions of Tableware_cfg.py:31-38; the reset randomization of Tableware.py:157 onwards (object instance, scale, position, texture and lighting) is not modelled
the fake does not model task success: the 0.035 m XY distance check of utils/success_checker.py:97-113 is not evaluated

the episode time limit is a placeholder of 7200 fake steps derived from episode_length_s 60 and dt 1/120 s; the termination and truncation rule itself is in the external DirectRLEnv, and the fake marks both flags on time-out as Tableware.py:137-139 does

the upstream task needs Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, the external Assets/ dataset and a CUDA GPU (README.md:45-54 and :74-86); it was never started here, so the upstream simulator path and any agreement with it are not claimed
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0 and clock lockstep
snapshot and restore are not offered: the fake exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
